description: The connected account: tier, persona, corpus freshness, and every limit — what is left in the current window, and the caps that do not renew. Call it when a user asks about limits, when you are unsure whether you are authenticated, or to confirm a setting took.

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: whoami
title: Who am I, and what is left
